verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is Portugal's national industrial-property office. Its evidence covers filing and maintaining patents, utility models, designs and trademarks under Portuguese jurisdiction. A user-selectable storage region is a multi-region SaaS concept that does not fit a national registry, whose records are tied to its jurisdiction, and nothing in the pack suggests it offers any such choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
